_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR EVERY PRICE ON THE SITE.
Edit the numbers here and re-upload this file — the calculator and every
published rate table update immediately. Nothing else needs changing.
Easiest way to edit: open /admin-pricing.html on the site, change the
prices in the form, then click 'Download pricing.json' and upload the new
All prices are in CAD and are ESTIMATES / STARTING PRICES, never
Run `node tools/test_pricing.js` after any change — it re-checks every
number against the owner's written price guide.

residential._included_in_NOTE: Add-ons covered by the chosen package show as 'included' and cost $0. Inside fridge, inside oven, interior windows, carpet and upholstery are PAID ADD-ONS ON EVERY PACKAGE by the owner's instruction.
residential._recurring_NOTE: Discount applies to the base package price only — never to add-ons, carpet, upholstery or commercial. First clean is always full price.

regular.label: Regular cleaning
includes: Kitchen surfaces and exterior of appliances

deep.label: Deep cleaning
includes: More detailed cleaning of surfaces and built-up grime

moveinout.label: Move-in / move-out cleaning
includes: Inside of empty cabinets and drawers

residential.always_paid_note: Inside fridge, inside oven, interior windows, carpet cleaning and upholstery cleaning are optional paid add-ons on every package, including deep and move-in / move-out.

commercial._NOTE: Automatic estimates apply to standard offices and retail only. Every other property type is a custom quote.
commercial.recurring_note: Recurring commercial contracts are priced individually — tell us your schedule and we will quote it properly rather than repeating the one-time rate.
commercial.disclaimer: Starting estimate per visit. The final commercial quote depends on the property type, actual cleanable square footage, condition, cleaning frequency, number of washrooms, scope of work and any special cleaning requirements. Commercial carpet and upholstery extraction is quoted separately.

_minimum_NOTE: MINIMUM APPOINTMENT TOTAL, not an extra fee. It applies to standalone bookings — individual services, carpet and/or upholstery with no cleaning package. If the selected services total less than this, the customer pays this amount. Once the selection reaches or exceeds it, they pay the actual total. When a residential or commercial cleaning package is booked for the same visit the floor does not apply at all, and add-ons are simply added at their normal price.
max_room_note: A room counts as up to 250 sq ft (roughly 15 ft x 16 ft). Rooms larger than this, large basements and open-plan areas are measured and quoted separately.

carpet._stairs_NOTE: Stairs are charged per individual step: per_step x number of steps.

disclaimer: Estimated price only — not a guaranteed final price. Your final price may be higher or lower depending on the actual condition, size and services required. Any price adjustment will be confirmed with you before work begins.
minimum_explainer: A $139 minimum applies to standalone appointments. This is not an extra fee — if your selected services come to less than $139 the total is $139, and once they reach $139 or more you simply pay the actual total. Booking these alongside a house or commercial clean? The minimum does not apply.
submit_disclaimer: You are sending a quote request, not making a purchase. The figure above is an estimate based on what you selected. We confirm the final price with you before any work begins.
estimate_factors: Final pricing can change with the actual square footage, number of bathrooms, property condition, level of buildup, stains, pet hair or odours, excessive clutter, accessibility, and any services added or removed.
treatments_note: Heavy stain and pet odour treatments are estimated additional charges. The exact amount depends on the condition, so the estimate is shown as a range and confirmed on site.
